$comment: Home page news manifest for the Evolution client. Editing this file publishes announcements without redeploying the app. Fields: id (unique, stable — player dismissals key off it), date (ISO, drives ordering + display), tone (arcane | gold | blue), link (optional, internal route or https URL), image (optional thumbnail, same-origin path or https URL), banner (optional https URL of a wide 3:1 image, 2172x724, for the news carousel of the ranking website; that site shows only items that have one, and the client ignores it), expiresAt (optional ISO instant, hides the item after it), kind (optional: shop | season | tournament, shows a tag and words the button by destination), eventAt (optional ISO instant, puts a shop or season item on the events calendar), eventEndAt (optional ISO instant after eventAt, for something that runs for several days: the calendar shows it on each of them), title/summary (per-locale, a missing locale falls back to the other). The home panel shows the 3 newest non-expired, non-dismissed items.

title.es-419: La Temporada 8 empieza el 1 de diciembre

summary.es-419: Una nueva temporada arranca el 1 de diciembre: los rankings vuelven a cero y la carrera a la cima queda abierta otra vez.
summary.en: A new season begins on December 1: the rankings reset and the race to the top is wide open again.

summary.es-419: Edison deja la beta: el formato de 2010 con sus textos y rulings de época, listo para jugar en serio.
summary.en: Edison leaves beta: the 2010 format with its era-correct texts and rulings, ready for serious play.

summary.es-419: El formato de 2005 llega en beta con sus cartas pre-errata. Juégalo y cuéntanos en Discord qué encuentras.
summary.en: The 2005 format arrives in beta with its pre-errata cards. Play it and tell us on Discord what you find.

summary.es-419: Rush Duel sale de la beta: duelos rápidos, cinco cartas en mano y un turno que nunca se detiene.
summary.en: Rush Duel is out of beta: fast duels, five cards in hand and turns that never slow down.

summary.es-419: Duelos rápidos con zonas reducidas y Skills. Pruébalo en beta y cuéntanos en Discord qué encuentras.
summary.en: Quick duels with fewer zones and Skills. Try it in beta and tell us on Discord what you find.

summary.es-419: Del 1 al 24 de diciembre, abre una puerta cada día y llévate una recompensa.
summary.en: From December 1 to 24, open a door each day and take a reward.

summary.es-419: Hazle saber a tu rival cuánto te molestó esa trampa. El pack Cara de Enojo ya está en la tienda.
summary.en: Let your opponent know how much that trap annoyed you. The Angry Face pack is now in the shop.

summary.es-419: La ranita aprendió magia. El avatar Baby Frog Mage ya está en la tienda.
summary.en: The little frog learned magic. The Baby Frog Mage avatar is now in the shop.

summary.es-419: Viste tu deck de noche. La funda Murciélago ya está en la tienda.
summary.en: Dress your deck for the night. The Bat sleeve is now in the shop.

summary.es-419: Las cartas de Edison ya funcionan con sus textos y rulings pre-errata, tal como se jugaba en 2010.
summary.en: Edison cards now play with their pre-errata texts and rulings, just as the format played in 2010.
